basic_profile.bio: An avid libertarian from Austin, Texas, I spend my days working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a keen interest in political discourse and often find myself engaged in debates about liberty and governance. Outside of politics, I am a huge fan of high heels and collect them as a hobby. I'm usually online in the late evenings after wrapping up work. Single and enjoying the freedom that comes with it, I value open-minded discussions and have a particular disdain for authoritarianism in all its forms.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My understanding of political ideologies comes from a mix of self-study and participation in various online forums. I have no formal education in political science but have spent years reading books and articles on libertarianism, geopolitics, and economic theories. My interest in fashion, especially high heels, is purely self-taught through online communities and personal experimentation.
